sql_reading_A.sql:
WITH duo_list AS (
    SELECT MOIRA_LIST_KEY
    FROM MOIRA_LIST
    WHERE LOWER(MOIRA_LIST_NAME) = 'duo users'
),
list_students AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME AS FULL_NAME
    FROM MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL d
    JOIN duo_list l
      ON d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = l.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
    JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY s
      ON d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME = s.FULL_NAME
)
SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT ls.FULL_NAME) AS student_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.DEPARTMENT) AS department_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sd.SCHOOL_NAME) AS school_count
FROM list_students ls
JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY s
  ON ls.FULL_NAME = s.FULL_NAME
LEFT JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd
  ON s.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE;
